fears.kicker: The three ways gifting goes wrong
fears.heading: Name the fear. Check the mechanism.
fears.intro: You cannot buy certainty with promises. You can buy it with mechanisms you get to verify. Flip each fear over.

cards.mechanism: Backward planning with the factory calendar built in, an order by date in writing, and weekly photos from every factory on your run. If a week slips, you hear it that week, not in December.
One golden sample, approved by you, locked as the standard. AQL inspection on the assembled boxes against that sample before anything ships. You see the report, not a reassurance.
One quote that names every line: product, print, assembly, freight, duties, our fee. Payments move in milestones after proof moments, never one deposit and silence.

fears.milestonesNote: The exact split is set in your quote. The shape never changes: proof first, payment after.
fears.modesHeading: What we inspect for on a gifting run
modes: Wrong item count inside the box
Print errors on the card or sleeve
The wrong language card in a region's box
Batteries that cannot fly, flagged before freight booking, not at the airport

sample.heading: Sample the idea before you order the batch.
sample.body: Any factory in our network can build a single sample of your actual product, not a preset box, for a sample development fee, credited in full against your order. You hold the real thing in two to three weeks, before a single unit is batch produced.
sample.honestNote: Honest frame: a single sample usually means digital print or a placeholder finish. Techniques like embossing or screen printing only become available at production scale. We tell you exactly which is which when your sample arrives.
sample.replyNote: We reply within one working day.
steps: It lands on your desk in 2 to 3 weeks

honest.kicker: Why there are no testimonials here
honest.heading: Quotes we write ourselves prove nothing.
honest.body: CUSTOM+ is a young company. I would rather tell you that than decorate this page with five star reviews you cannot check. The logos below come from real production work. If you want to know what working with us is actually like, I will connect you to a client and you can ask them anything.

occasions.kicker: Occasions that already justify a box
occasions.heading: Every year gives you a reason. Here are ten.
occasions.intro: Flip a card to see the idea. Open it for how we would actually run it.

cards.title: Christmas closing
cards.idea: A box that goes further than a bottle of wine.
cards.detail: The busiest gifting week of the year, and the one most likely to hit a factory closure if briefed late.

cards.title: New year
cards.idea: Something useful for the new work year, not a calendar.
cards.detail: A quieter moment to open the year with clients or teams, without the December rush.

cards.title: Company anniversary
cards.idea: A numbered piece, not a mug with a logo on it.
cards.detail: Round numbers deserve something that will not end up in a drawer.

cards.title: Product launch
cards.idea: A preview kit for press or early customers.
cards.detail: Timed to land before the announcement, not after it.

cards.title: Contract renewal
cards.idea: A personal thank you, not a standard fruit basket.
cards.detail: The moment a client re signs is the moment they are most open to noticing you.

cards.title: Opening
cards.idea: One box that marks the day the doors open, for the team and the first guests.
cards.detail: A new location, store or office deserves its own box: something branded for the team on day one, plus a smaller version to hand to the first visitors.

cards.title: New client welcome
cards.idea: A first impression as sharp as the proposal.
cards.detail: Sets the tone before the first invoice does.

cards.title: Trade show & events
cards.idea: A giveaway that survives the walk back to the hotel.
cards.detail: Built to be picked, not just picked up.

cards.title: Project thank you
cards.idea: Something that makes the project itself memorable.
cards.detail: Sent at the exact moment the client is already thinking well of you.

cards.title: Sinterklaas
cards.idea: A themed surprise box, no clichés, no coal.
cards.detail: Playful and seasonal, delivered before the fifth. Timing is the whole point here.

otherCard.title: Something else?
otherCard.detail: Not every reason to send a gift fits a card. Describe yours and we will tell you honestly whether it works.
